title: IELTS Vocabulary Practice - IELTS Vocabulary - Confusing Words
subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: The new manager has had a positive ______ on the team's morale.
questions.explain: 'Effect' is a noun (a result), whereas 'affect' is usually a verb (to influence).
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: The salad really ______ the main course perfectly.
questions.explain: 'Complement' (with an 'e') means to add to something in a way that enhances or improves it. 'Compliment' (with an 'i') is to praise.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: My **principal** reason for moving was to be closer to work.
questions.explain: 'Principal' (adjective) means main or most important. 'Principle' refers to a truth or rule.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary
